title: New feature announcement
description: Announce a product launch on WhatsApp with a one-line benefit and a link to try it. Marketing template for SaaS teams. Copy it and adapt the brand.
notes: Lead with the user benefit, not the feature name. Send only to users who opted in to product news.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, {{feature}} just landed in Lumen. {{benefit}}. It is live in your workspace today.

benefit.example: Build a weekly summary in two clicks instead of two hours
